title: 🔆🔅TABRIZ - Oct 14, 2026 -- Mohammad Jafar Ghaempanah, Vice President of Iran for Executive Affairs, made remarks at a meeting with officials of East Azerbaijan Province.
text:
🔆🔅TABRIZ - Oct 14, 2026 -- Mohammad Jafar Ghaempanah, Vice President of Iran for Executive Affairs, made remarks at a meeting with officials of East Azerbaijan Province."

" SOT1, Mohammad Jafar Ghaempanah, Vice President of Iran for Executive Affairs (Farsi) (00:00 - 00:29): "A country like America is truly seeking to plunder our resources, including oil, and, most importantly, oil and gas. To the extent that Trump explicitly declared that they want to take Kharg and take Iran's oil, just as they did with Venezuela. Ultimately, he spoke his mind, Trump's mind, the mind of the American regime.""

"SOT2, Mohammad Jafar Ghaempanah, Vice President of Iran for Executive Affairs (Farsi) (00:30 - 00:41): "The reality is that America will not tolerate an independent Iran. We have been struggling for forty-seven years now for this freedom; we have been struggling for forty-seven years for this independence.""

"SOT3, Mohammad Jafar Ghaempanah, Vice President of Iran for Executive Affairs (Farsi) (00:42 - 01:11): "We are not actually seeking nuclear weapons. The reality is that our nuclear energy is truly peaceful, and as far as I know, I have gone and visited, part of it is medical, the majority is for medicine and agriculture. Part of it is for industry, and fortunately, we possess the knowledge for it. Now, it is possible that they might strike some of our enrichment facilities, but the reality is that we have the capability and the scientific knowledge for this work.""

"SOT4, Mohammad Jafar Ghaempanah, Vice President of Iran for Executive Affairs (Farsi) (01:12 - 01:43): "Ultimately, we are faced with the fact that America does not want us to be independent. They have started a war and are sanctioning us; they have already imposed sanctions, and now they are implementing oil sanctions in every real sense. Despite all the pressures during this period, we have continued to sell oil, but now they actually want us to have a non-oil economy. We must now base our assumptions on a non-oil economy.""

"SOT5, Mohammad Jafar Ghaempanah, Vice President of Iran for Executive Affairs (Farsi) (01:44 - 02:16): "Shall we surrender or defend our interests with our own power? This does not necessarily mean war. We do not choose the path of war either. They started the war. But ultimately, we must manage our economy and our country with this situation. All our efforts are aimed at breaking this blockade somehow, whether through diplomacy or military means.""

"SOT6, Mohammad Jafar Ghaempanah, Vice President of Iran for Executive Affairs (Farsi) (02:17 - 02:38): "We are not people of war, and war eventually ends in diplomacy and peace. But they are the ones who want war, now more behind the scenes, their propaganda is heavy; the reality is that they are warmongers; the reality is that, ultimately, they think they must win through war.
